title: Presenting a project
objective: Présenter un projet concret, justifier des choix et répondre à des questions

steps.title: Warm-up
steps.student_instruction: Think of one project that could improve your school. Share one idea.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Proposer des exemples neutres: reading club, school garden, recycling campaign.

steps.title: Reading a model pitch
steps.student_instruction: Read the short pitch. Underline the aim, two actions and the expected result.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Texte modèle: Our project is a school reading club. We want students to discover new books. First, we will organize a weekly meeting. Then, we will create a book exchange shelf. This could help students read more and meet new people.

steps.title: Language toolkit
steps.student_instruction: Match: Our aim is / First / We could / Because / Finally to their functions.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Repérer objectif, organisation, proposition, justification et conclusion; pratiquer will / could / should en contexte.

steps.title: Differentiated planning
steps.student_instruction: Prepare your A, B or C project sheet. Use the planning grid.
steps.facilitator_instruction: A: phrases à compléter; B: projet en 5 points; C: contraintes et objections à anticiper.

steps.title: Pitch and questions
steps.student_instruction: Present your project to a small group. Ask and answer at least one question.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Groupes de 3; tours de parole; évaluer structure, clarté et interaction, sans surcorriger.

steps.title: Exit ticket
steps.student_instruction: Write one improvement you would make to your project pitch.

sheets.student_content: Complete: Our project is ___. We want to ___. First, we will ___. Then, we will ___. It will help because ___.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Réponses libres; vérifier présence d'un objectif, de deux actions et d'une justification compréhensible.

sheets.student_content: Create a 60–90 second pitch with: aim, audience, two actions, benefit and conclusion. Prepare two questions.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Exemple: Our project is a school garden. We want to make our school greener. First, we will choose a place. Then, we will plant flowers. It could help students learn about nature. Thank you for listening.

sheets.student_content: Prepare a 90-second pitch. Add two possible difficulties, a solution for each and one answer to a critical question.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Réponse ouverte; critères: faisabilité, justifications, structure, interaction et solutions adaptées.

criteria: L'élève présente un objectif et deux actions
L'élève justifie au moins un choix
